treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Slovenia and the Republic of Kosovo for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2013)
eif_quote: [Obvestilo, Uradni list RS - MP, št. 33/2014 (9 May 2014), reproduced by racunovodstvo.net] da je dne 16. aprila 2014 začela veljati Konvencija med Republiko Slovenijo in Republiko Kosovo ... || [Art. 28(2)(a)] This Convention shall be applicable: a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force;
source_title: Uradni list RS - Mednarodne pogodbe 104/2013 (MP 16/2013), item 78: Zakon o ratifikaciji Konvencije med Republiko Slovenijo in Republiko Kosovo (BXKIDO), English text

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT/LOB article in treaty; MLI not applicable - Kosovo not an MLI party)

notes: Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) when paid by/to Government, political subdivision, local authority or Central Bank, or on loans made/guaranteed/insured by the other State's export-credit institution - not modelled. Slovenia, Albanian and English texts authentic; English prevails. Gazette "Mednarodne pogodbe" no. 16/2013 is published within Uradni list RS no. 104/2013 (13 Dec 2013). Entry into force 16 April 2014 per the notice in Uradni list RS - MP 33/2014 (read via racunovodstvo.net reproduction) and Slovenia's MLI list; ATK lists 14.04.2014 (conflict, minor). Kosovo is not an MLI party.
